30 /// Reads the keys of one JSON object into fields, remembering which keys were asked for so
31 /// that any other key can be reported.
32 class Reader {
33 public:
34 /// A reader of one object at `path`.
35 /// @param json The object; it must outlive the reader.
36 /// @throws ConfigError at `path` if `json` is not an object.
37 Reader(const Json& json, std::string path);
38
39 /// Reads a key into a field when present, else remembers it for `Finish` when `range`
40 /// requires it; `description` and `unit` are for `ConfigSchema`.
41 /// @throws ConfigError at the key's path for a value that does not fit.
42 template <typename T>
43 void operator()(std::string_view key, T& value, std::string_view description = {},
44 std::string_view unit = {}, const FieldRange& range = {});

63 /// Writes fields as the keys of a JSON object, in order.
64 class Writer {
65 public:
66 /// A writer into one object.
67 /// @param json The object to write; it must outlive the writer.
68 /// @param omitUnset Whether unset optional fields of this object are left out rather than
69 /// written as null; the objects inside it write theirs as null.
70 /// @param compact Whether the objects inside it leave out lists that are empty, as they are
71 /// by default (`FieldsJson`).
72 19098 explicit Writer(Json& json, bool omitUnset = false, bool compact = false)
73 19098 : m_json(json), m_omitUnset(omitUnset), m_compact(compact) {}
74
75 /// Writes a field as a key; `description` and `unit` are for `ConfigSchema`.
76 template <typename T>
77 void operator()(std::string_view key, T& value, std::string_view description = {},
78 std::string_view unit = {}, const FieldRange& range = {});
79
80 private:
81 Json& m_json;
82 bool m_omitUnset = false;
83 bool m_compact = false;
84 };

86 /// Whether `Fields(reader, value)` is callable with a `Reader`.
87 template <typename T, typename = void> struct HasFieldsTrait : std::false_type {};
88 template <typename T>
89 struct HasFieldsTrait<T, std::void_t<decltype(Fields(std::declval<Reader&>(), std::declval<T&>()))>>
90 : std::true_type {};
91
92 /// A struct read and written as a JSON object through its `Fields`.
93 template <typename T> inline constexpr bool HasFields = HasFieldsTrait<T>::value;
94
95 /// An unsigned integer type other than bool, read and written as a non-negative integer.
96 template <typename T>
97 inline constexpr bool IsUnsignedInteger =
98 std::is_integral_v<T> && std::is_unsigned_v<T> && !std::is_same_v<T, bool>;
99
